feed_id.description: Stable identifier for this feed series (updates may chain via previous_feed_payload_sha256).

feed_version.description: Schema version of this feed payload.

generated_at.description: When this feed payload was generated (best effort).

window_max_entries.description: If present, the intended maximum size of entries[] in this feed (windowed feed).

previous_feed_payload_sha256.description: Optional digest of the previous PublicNoticeFeed *payload* bytes in this series (rollback/rewrites detection).

sequence.description: Optional monotonically increasing counter for operator convenience. Not authoritative without the hash chain.

notice_payload_sha256.description: Digest of the PublicNotice payload object bytes (content-addressed statement).

notice_tbs_sha256.description: Optional digest of the PublicNotice envelope TBS bytes (helps cross-check binding).

packet_manifest_sha256.description: Optional digest of the manifest.json bytes for the packet that published this notice (if applicable).

issued_at.description: Optional copy of the PublicNotice issued_at time (for sorting).

channels.description: Optional canonical channel IDs where the notice was published (see official-channels.csv).

mirrors.description: Optional mirror URLs/URIs where the notice envelope or packet can be fetched.

notes.description: Optional short note (avoid narratives; the notice is the narrative).
Optional short notes for operators/observers (avoid narratives).

ordering.description: Optional declaration of entries[] ordering. Recommended: issued_at_desc_notice_id_asc. Use unspecified if legacy feeds cannot commit to ordering.
